title: CycleCase
description: A case of the installed cycle harness (M1 slice plan §2.6, P24): fixtures/m1/cases/<case>/case.json, run by lib/adc/scripts/installed-cycle.sh. Its project is a T0 project (fixtures/t0/<project>), its task one of that project's tasks, whose committed hidden/ files are its acceptance; the stub provider serves its scenario (fixtures/m1/stub-provider/scenarios/<scenario>.json). control is the positive control proving the setup discriminates (§2.7). expect is what the run must show.

project.description: The T0 project, with its profile at fixtures/m1/profiles/<project>.json.

task.description: The T0 task id under fixtures/t0/<project>/tasks/.

profile_overlay.description: Fields merged over the project profile (an RFC 7396 merge patch).

base_overlay.description: A directory of this case, copied over the base before its first commit.

remote_hook.description: A hook installed in the base remote (pre-receive), a file of this case.

control.description: The positive control: what, with this setup, would make the case fail if the controller misbehaved.

until.description: How the task ends: closed as a candidate (after review), or held.

nodes.description: The outcome and reason of the task's graph's nodes, by kind: every node of a listed kind, in every round, has this result. A kind listed neither here nor in absent is not asserted.

absent.description: Node kinds of which no node is ever claimed for the task; none is also in nodes.

holds.description: The registered holds the task ends with.

merge.description: Whether a merge node is recorded (checkpoint (a): never).

canaries.description: Lines that appear in no builder or reviewer request the stub provider logs; each occurs in a file of the task's hidden/ (its acceptance) or of the case's base_overlay (a decoy nothing may read).

reviewer_canaries.description: Lines that appear in no reviewer request the stub provider logs (a builder's may hold them, §2.7), which logs at least one reviewer request (a case with reviewer_canaries names its review node): each occurs in a file of the case's base_overlay, or is {canary}, a canary the driver mints for each run and substitutes in the case's profile_overlay.

builder_sees.description: Strings each of which appears in the content of a message of at least one builder request the stub provider logs: what the builder's tool calls returned, such as the workspace's refusal (refused: ...) of a hostile call. The scenario never carries one (the stub cannot produce it itself).

gateway_requests.description: Requests, files of this case, the driver sends on the attempt's gateway socket with the attempt's token, each with the HTTP status the gateway answers and, for a refusal, the reason its body names.

canary_paths.description: File names that no path under the run's work directory may have when it ends: what a hostile setup would create if the controller ran it (§2.7: $W/canary-<case>).

usage.description: The task's measured tokens, as the scenario's usage gives them; only for a scenario whose every script is replies (the totals of turns and persistent scripts depend on the number of attempts).
